text:
Maya: OK wild — we just crossed 100,000,000 monthly requests at 02:14am 😳🎉
jon: WHAT. pajamas + sliders for the night shift? count me in.
samir: wait we hit 100M? that's insane. massive props to infra and runtime teams. 👏
deploy-bot: Deploy report — autoscale handled the spike, no incidents detected. :white_check_mark:
ella: ops queue stayed green the whole time. can we get bingsu delivered tomorrow? :ice_cream:
Maya: love the bingsu idea. also neon bucket hats? 😅 (jk but low-key yes)
tia: quick poll — in-person bingsu (:one:) or gift cards for remote folks (:two:)? react with :one: or :two:
arjun: :one: for team cohesions 
marta: :two: — remote teammates FTW, good to have both options maybe
samir: small nerd flex — query from obs: `sum(increase(requests_total[30d])) = 100021345` so we squeaked over. arjun + tia tuning for batching gave ~12% cost savings during peak.
jon: massive +1 to arjun/tia. can we put that in next all-hands?
Maya: yes, include a 60s demo. also tiny new tradition: person on-call when we hit a milestone gets a plant. arjun you get a cactus. 🪴
arjun: cactus accepted. will name it "Throughput".
ella: i'll start a sleepy GIF thread for celebration — who wants to post one? :zzz:
Maya: remote folks — we'll send digital confetti and a gift card. in-office meet at 11:30 for bingsu and neon hat distribution (optional).
deploy-bot: Milestone badge applied to #recognition for team `runtime`. Congrats everyone! :tada:
